headline: Multiple Marcus Mariota Starts Likely For Commanders; Jayden Daniels IR Stint Not Certain

headline: Jayden Daniels consulting specialists after dislocating left elbow Sunday
summary: Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels dislocated his left elbow during Sunday's loss to the Cowboys and is now trying to sort out how long he will be out of action as a result of the injury.

headline: Giants QB Jaxson Dart exits MNF game vs. Rams with knee injury
summary: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart was ruled out for Monday night's game against the Rams after taking a hard hit on his left knee in the first quarter.

headline: Dallas Goedert sprained his MCL, will miss a few weeks
summary: Eagles tight end Dallas Goedert underwent an MRI on his injured right knee on Monday.
